notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h3]New features[/h3]
- The game now supports controllers and automatically detects when you are using one.
- In the game settings, you can disable automatic controller detection if the game detects a device that you neither want to use nor disconnect.
- Most buttons can be freely reassigned. The exceptions are the D-pad and the axes for movement and looking around.
- If the game displays incorrect button labels for your controller, try changing the "button layout" option in the settings.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- The camera work while riding on animals no longer requires constant correction of the viewing direction during turns.
- Kasimir now dries off much faster when wet, especially near a lit stove.
- Manure pits and composters are now twice as capacious (therefore, the visual level of filling has seemingly dropped by half).
- Most races can be run on animals of either gender, so nothing stands in the way of defeating stallion Filip on the back of a mare.
- Our beloved Tekla is finally starting to feel her age. Our fistfight champion is now slightly less combative, but still not to be underestimated.

notes.title: 02/03 Devlog! Bless me Father, for I have sinned
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39413983/d88d94651582bd74c810773ab3d69e880187ac44.png[/img]

“Bless me Father, for I have sinned. I know you're looking at me. I tried to follow Your commandments. They seem to be simple - „You shall not steal” „You shall not covet your neighbor’s goods.” But not for the simple farm man.I am ready for the punishment! But Y should know that I had no choice. You left me here to die. With no hope, no sign, no help. I will survive by all means.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39413983/fd2189d64311d9e1e773ae416dd9ce7813f1cff9.png[/img]

Moonshine making brought me some peace. How can you blame me for that, Father?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39413983/b2d1239f27628eb8eb36471ec5cf31f95ebcd1ab.png[/img]

My apple orchard bore fruits. I guess you can't be that mad at me. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39413983/9d825fe708805afcd02a1203b33ca4b6970363b3.png[/img]

And Krasula... will fawn in days. You give some much Father and take much more. Why does it have to be like that!" 

Kasimir's Journal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39413983/443048bc3edf8ea0f3f5e2b9bb6b1814f4f89875.png[/img]

Morality system - for now, every decision will have it's consequences. Street fights, drinking alcohol, kicking animals will make you a bad guy and can shorten your life! Going to the mass, forest cleaning will help you in redemption.

https://vimeo.com/529403567

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39413983/4b8b410f4b865b431b466c20ca8deaf5193ed1ba.png[/img]
